messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help with my upcoming flight. I thought I added insurance to my booking, but when I check online, it’s not showing up. I’m traveling with my family and everyone else has insurance on their tickets, so I really want to make sure I have it too. Can you help me sort this out?

I can help you with your insurance concern. To assist you, could you please provide your user ID and the reservation ID for your booking? If you don’t know your reservation ID, let me know and I can help you locate it.

Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and the reservation number is PEP4E0. I really want to make sure I have insurance on this flight, just like the rest of my family. Can you check what’s going on and help me get it added if it’s missing?

I’ve checked your reservation (PEP4E0), and currently, there is no travel insurance included for your ticket. 

Unfortunately, according to our policy, travel insurance can only be added at the time of the initial booking and cannot be added afterward. I’m unable to add insurance to your reservation at this stage.

If you have any other questions or need help with your booking, please let me know.

I really need to have insurance for this flight, just like my family members do. Is there absolutely no way to add it now? I’m not comfortable traveling without it, and it’s really important to me. Can you please double-check if there’s anything you can do or if there are any exceptions? I’d really appreciate your help.

I understand how important travel insurance is for your peace of mind. I’ve double-checked our policy, and unfortunately, I am not able to add insurance to your reservation after the initial booking—this rule applies to all reservations, and there are no exceptions allowed through our system.

If you would like, I can transfer you to a human agent to see if they have any additional options or can make an exception for your situation. Would you like me to do that?

No, I really don’t want to be transferred. I’d prefer to keep working with you directly. Is there anything else you can suggest or any other way I can get insurance for this flight? I just want to make sure I’m covered like the rest of my family.

Thank you for your understanding and for letting me know your preference. Based on the airline’s policy and the tools available to me, I am unable to add travel insurance to your existing reservation or suggest any way to add it through our system after booking is complete.

If you have any other questions about your reservation, need to make changes, or require assistance with anything else related to your flight, I’m here to help. Please let me know how I can assist you further.

I understand, but I’m really frustrated that I can’t get insurance now, especially since my whole family has it. Are you sure there’s absolutely nothing that can be done? I just want to be sure I’m protected for this trip. If there’s any way at all, please let me know.

I completely understand your frustration and your desire to be protected for your trip. I’ve reviewed the policy thoroughly, and unfortunately, there is no way for me to add travel insurance to your reservation after the booking has been completed. This restriction is set by the airline and applies to all reservations without exception.

If you have any other concerns or need help with your reservation in any other way, please let me know. I’m here to assist you with anything else you might need for your upcoming trip.
Alright, I understand. I’m disappointed, but thank you for checking and explaining everything to me. That’s all I needed for now.

You’re very welcome, and I’m sorry I couldn’t do more regarding the insurance. If you have any other questions or need assistance with your reservation in the future, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Safe travels to you and your family!
